# A09-S83: Operating costs

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

Thanks for that :-) Shall we just get it applied for? I can write a draft that we can send after launch.

An important thing she writes is probably about some form of self-financing being expected. Is there a budget in Community for the practical aspects of such an event? So we can focus the application on payment for external artists and researchers we invite?

Another thing regarding finances is that […] we can set up a screen with the chatbot at the event. I would of course like that, but would then like to have the account details for usage changed to a MindFuture account. As I have interpreted our contract, I pay for the training and development of the AI through your payment to me. But I do not cover when it then passes over to the right of use.

Right now every interaction with it pulls on my finances. It's not expensive for individual interactions, but I also need to use the given money to set up an OpenAI alternative, and it would be nice to have clear lines on this :-)

I'm really looking forward to launch!!
